text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having claimed two crowns and now heading 
for the Kikuka Sho, Symboli Rudolf was the 
talk of the town.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, Sirius Symboli, who was 
usually so composed, showed a rare flash 
of irritation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without anyone else understanding the true 
reason, the Saudi Arabia Royal Cup quietly 
got underway.
